Name: Em's Goose (SVE animals)
Author: Rivalrabbit
Description:
A new design and four colour options for the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]SVE[/url] goose
Including the goose and Marnie's livestock shop icon. Eggs and goose mayo are optional
Available for Content Patcher and Alternative Textures
Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29997]Livestock Bazaar[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url]

The different types are:
Embden (white)
Greylag (brown)
Scania (brown white)
Canada (black brown)

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/W1HQ4bKW/CP.png[/img]

Download and install the latest [url=https://smapi.io///]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher
[/url]Download and unzip "Em's SVE Goose CP"
Move the folder to \Stardew Valley\Mods\
Enjoy!

When buying a goose from Marnie, the type gets randomised and can be any of the four options
If you rather choose which type of bear you get, you can use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29997]Livestock Bazaar
[/url]
Alternatively, you can choose "Em's SVE Goose CP [b]Config"[/b]
This allows you to choose one type of goose for your farm with a config.json

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/zD9Q1d3r/Goose-Config.png[/img]

To change the default goose or disable the egg and mayo:
Open the [i]config.json[/i] file in the goose mod folder
Replace "[color=#e69138]Embden[/color]" with the name of the type you like
Save and close the folder again, and you're all set!
Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url]

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/MGb2cDyd/Patchnotes.png[/img]

﻿[i]Update 1.1 Compatible with livestock bazaar, two new types, animation improvements[/i]

[i]Note: If you would like geese on your farm, but don't have sve, take a look at [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/43600]Em's Farm Geese[/url]
These are the same geese, but don't require sve. Both can be installed side by side, but simply have the same sprites[/i]
